title: 秋華賞の後に・変わったのは

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, what're you doing, dunderhead!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (I finished the race, and I did good too! But…)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: There was noth'n dazzl'n about my runn'n…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: SQUEEEEE!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan A
text_block_list.text: Yukino! You're looking extra cute today!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan B
text_block_list.text: I couldn't take my eyes off of you! You were so totally "dazzl'n"!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan B
text_block_list.text: You're a total city girl now! I can't wait to see you in concert!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That made me a city girl?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Was I really that dazzl'n? It sure didn't feel like it…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But if that's what everyone's say'n, maybe I should just be happy…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But if this is all it took… what have I been work'n so hard for?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yukino…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: So you're feeling it now too…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I feel like I don't know anyth'n anymore.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I wanted t'become the city girl ev'ryone wants t'cheer for, but…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Here they are, cheer'n me on and tell'n me I shine plenty now.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Maybe the only one who wants me to change… is me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But then… How'm I s'posed to run? What do I run for?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …Sorry. I'm being a real party pooper, aren't I? We should be decid'n my next race.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But…
choice_data_list: Let's treat ourselves to a nice dinner.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sorry…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the adult here, there are a number of ways I could go about trying to comfort Yukino Bijin, but I'm not the person she really needs right now.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh no! Mifuyu's already split!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well, at least I got t'talk to her a bit. She's been cheer'n me up as long as I can remember.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's her friend that she needs. Those two have always lifted each other up and pushed the other forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I could say anything in the world to her, but her friend would do infinitely more to reach her heart.

text_block_list.name: Bandwagon Fan A
text_block_list.text: Yukino was soooo cute! Literally my fave for life!

text_block_list.name: Bandwagon Fan B
text_block_list.text: Hey, look at this video! She's an idol who just debuted. Isn't she adorable?!

text_block_list.name: Bandwagon Fan A
text_block_list.text: Wow, you weren't kidding! Oh man, I think I might've just found my new obsession!
